Class DeviceState

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.model.DeviceState
public class DeviceState extends Object
Central state store for a connected Meshtastic device.

Contains the node database, channels, configuration, channel and direct messages, telemetry, and pending ACK tracking. Each TCP connection receives its own DeviceState through ConnectionManager.

After refactoring, most operations are delegated to components: NodeDatabase, ChannelStore, ConfigStore, and MessageStore. UI updates are performed through Platform.runLater().

      public void clear()
      Fully resets device state: clears nodeDb, channels, configuration, all messages, pending ACKs, owner info, and telemetry history. Pending fixed position is intentionally not reset because it must survive reconnection.
